Independent non-author exact-SHA documentation review: FAIL for b3c7a95fd0d53772488c7dd0504c52961b2249d7 on parent e61b6bdae7423c9e8cd885dc50a20ce685f79280.

Mechanical and focused evidence is green. The allowlist resolves to exactly 59 targets across exactly 18 declared paths, comprising 49 leading docstrings and 10 full-line comment regions. The persisted immutable-prose-only and exact-leaf-paths checks pass. They confirm immutable targets equal the leaf parent, both trees parse with type_comments=True, only allowlisted leading docstrings are stripped, only ast.TypeIgnore.lineno is normalized, attribute-free ASTs match, protected prose and inline comments match, all 11 directive lines retain exact text and attachment, shebang count remains zero, every zero-context hunk stays in scope, and every target strictly shrinks. Focused pytest passes with 292 passed. Scoped Ruff check and format-check, comment hygiene, and diff integrity also pass. Full make verify was intentionally omitted under the documentation-only session direction; CI supplies repository-wide verification.

Blocking Stage 1 finding. docs/documentation-policy.md applies its writing rules to all new or edited maintained comments. It forbids semicolons, clause-joining colons, and the default banned authenticity adjectives real, actual, and genuine. This exact patch introduces those forms.

Banned adjective locations are tests/unit/test_live_dc_pass_health.py:4 (real killed process), tests/unit/test_llm_capabilities.py:5 (real profile), tests/unit/test_llm_config_gate_root.py:3 (real rebar.toml), tests/unit/test_llm_fallback_chain.py:109 (Build real models), tests/unit/test_llm_provider_factory.py:5 (real model objects), :71 (Build real providers), :73 (actual clients), :74 (real Agent path), and :188 (real clients), tests/unit/test_llm_timeouts.py:97 (real transport) and :401 (real scanned sibling), plus tests/unit/test_lock_age_ceiling.py:123 (genuine owner). Describe the concrete mechanism or source instead.

New semicolons occur at tests/unit/test_live_jira_dc_provisioning.py:187, tests/unit/test_llm_capabilities.py:5, tests/unit/test_llm_failure_matrix.py:107-108, tests/unit/test_llm_fallback_chain.py:5 and :111-112, tests/unit/test_llm_model_per_request.py:3, tests/unit/test_llm_provider_factory.py:3, tests/unit/test_llm_temperature.py:95, tests/unit/test_llm_timeouts.py:4, tests/unit/test_lock_age_ceiling.py:5, :123, and :160, and tests/unit/test_lock_container_recreate.py:5. Split or coordinate those clauses without semicolons. tests/unit/test_live_dc_isolation_controls_59b2.py:4 also uses a clause-joining colon in live harness: the pending-plan..., rather than an item-list or structural-label colon.

No 59-row TSV receipt is posted because the receipt contract requires PASS in all verdict columns, and this patch does not yet satisfy the project documentation policy. Amend the prose while keeping all 59 blocks strictly shorter, then request a fresh non-author review of the new full SHA. Reviewer session: /root/review_9793.
